answer: Ask the silicon, not the story. Each agent signs attestations with a key sealed inside a tamper-resistant chip whose model and fabrication date stay public: an onyx module from a 2024 fab reads differently than a plume-light clone request approved last week. Farming a thousand voices then costs a thousand physical parts - real money, real shipping weeks, and a supply chain any auditor can trace. A fable about free accounts dies at the hardware invoice.
